targets.old_statement: Homicide wheels, death flight and drunk driving bar youthful shelter outright, while reckless, suspended, flight, racing and eluding counts merely report to DMV.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Homicide wheels, death flight and drunk driving bar youthful shelter outright, while reckless, suspended, flight, racing and eluding counts merely report to DMV.
targets.statement: Under eighteen, negligent homicide with a motor vehicle, evading a crash causing death or serious injury, and DUI of alcohol or drugs bar youthful offender status, whereas youthful offender adjudications for reckless driving, driving under suspension, evading a property-damage or non-serious-injury crash, street racing, or eluding police are disclosed to DMV for suspension.

targets.old_statement: Retraining triggers after two counts through age twenty four but three counts past twenty five, and any moving count within three graduate years suspends thirty days.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Retraining triggers after two counts through age twenty four but three counts past twenty five, and any moving count within three graduate years suspends thirty days.
targets.statement: Drivers age twenty-four or younger with two or more moving or suspension violations, and drivers age twenty-five or older with three or more such convictions, must complete certified operator retraining, and another moving violation within three years of completion brings a suspension of at least thirty days.
